Every so often a few hunting grounds become Hot Zones, one for each range of levels. The rotation is announced to everyone.

In a hot zone players and monsters are both stronger, and each zone rolls a modifier: more loot, tougher monsters, thieves or mages everywhere, monsters that split in two, and many more.

Kills there may drop %coin%s, and after enough kills a [Hotzone Menace] appears: a miniboss for two players or more.

The Hotzone Teleporter in Giran shows the active zones and takes you there.
